aiReview.summary: Official DeepSeek API docs for pointing OpenAI Codex CLI, the ChatGPT desktop app, and the VS Code Codex extension at DeepSeek models via the Responses API, with a setup script and manual ~/.codex config.
evidence: Page title Integrate with Codex | DeepSeek API Docs at api-docs.deepseek.com.
States Codex talks to models via the Responses API, which DeepSeek natively supports.
Covers Codex CLI, ChatGPT desktop, and VS Code Codex IDE extension sharing ~/.codex.
Setup writes models.json for deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro and a model_providers.deepseek section.
uncertainty: Whether the CDN setup scripts match the documented steps at all times.
Runtime quality of DeepSeek models inside Codex versus OpenAI default models.
DeepSeek API pricing and regional availability.
aiReview.tagline: Point Codex clients at DeepSeek via Responses API
aiReview.description: Configure Codex CLI, desktop, and VS Code to use DeepSeek models with a setup script or ~/.codex config.toml and models.json.
pros: Documents Codex CLI, ChatGPT desktop, and VS Code Codex extension using one ~/.codex configuration.
Provides a one-click setup script plus a full manual models.json and config.toml field reference.
Uses DeepSeek’s native Responses API support rather than an unofficial proxy.
Script backs up config, validates TOML/JSON, and can restore defaults.
cons: Requires a DeepSeek API key and billed DeepSeek usage, not OpenAI-hosted models.
Setup script is curl|bash / irm|iex from DeepSeek’s CDN, which some users may reject.
Minimal Codex client version 0.144.0 is specified in the catalog.
